integrity: Exact-rational recurrence, full-profile enumeration to n=4 and universal proof included. No independent validation or certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Square one-seat matching; independent uniform complete strict rankings; serial dictatorship only. No claim for DA joint law, correlated preferences or actual Pareto-unimprovability. Exhaustive testing n<=4 is supplementary to analytic proof.
title: A joint envy-and-top-choice law for random serial dictatorship
